sdc.daemon.ModelRouteKind.title: ModelRouteKind
sdc.daemon.ModelRouteKind.description: What stands behind a route's alias at its gateway: managed (a model on a pod the gateway starts and stops), hosted (a fixed upstream, nothing started) or local (a model server on the gateway's machine, such as Ollama). The daemon's file says which; the daemon reads the status of a managed or a local route from the gateway, and sends a hosted route no call to probe it.

sdc.daemon.RouteNeeds.title: RouteNeeds
sdc.daemon.RouteNeeds.description: What a route entry of a runbook asks of a route when it names none (docs/model-routes.md, section 2): each member that is present is a requirement, checked against what the route's gateway lists for its alias (`GET /v1/models`: the wires, max_model_len, tool_calling) and the route's kind in the daemon's file. A fact the gateway did not give does not meet a requirement.

wire.description: A wire the gateway lists for the alias: chat, responses or messages.

min_context.description: The least max_model_len the gateway lists for the alias.

tool_calling.description: true: the gateway lists tool calling for the alias.
